requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-1486-4231-4452--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1651-5921-6754-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-5921-6754-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-5921-6754-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2228-4279-6634.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-6634.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-6634.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

698-4050-8077-8107.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
698-4050-8077-8107.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-4050-8077-8107.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Will.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2

2060-2744-3899-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-3899-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-3899-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

643-4302-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4302-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

710-3055-6495.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-3055-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-2146-3899-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1739-2146-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-4991-6972.description:
Activate Whisperwood Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Whisperwood Elemental dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Whisperwood Elemental ability.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2921-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

11-2103-5864-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2103-5864-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Capture of Jingzhou spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Capture of Jingzhou spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Capture of Jingzhou and returning the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Capture of Jingzhou from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

539-6620-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

372-1567-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1567-6991.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

511-817-4050-4365-6774.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

907-5478-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-5478-5702-6850.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

813-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
813-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake
When Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
813-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

323-2173-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1395-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

2067-6753-6787.easyPrerequisites: You have not created any tokens this turn.
2067-6753-6787.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of token copies of Exalted Sunborn equal to twice your life total due to Moonlit Meditation.
Whenever you create one or more tokens, you will instead create 2^X times that many tokens, where X is the number of Exalted Sunborns you control.
2067-6753-6787.notes: This combo can be done at any life total, but the higher the better. If you have 20 life, this combo makes 40 tokens in step 1, and then applies a multiplier of 2^41 for each token created afterwards, accounting for the 40 tokens and the nontoken Exalted Sunborn.

1409-3492-3609-4112.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Sharuum by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sharuum.
Repeat each turn.

193-3604-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
193-3604-4002.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory's second ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3604-4002.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

224-280-1359-1683.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-280-1359-1683.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Golgari Rot Farm on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3769-5256-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3769-5256-5434-5555.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-4848-5315-5687.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1429-2034-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2034-5402-5929.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

539-2713-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

307-914-2232-3612.notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
307-914-2232-3612.description:
Declare Dockside Extortionist as an attacker.
Arni Metalbrow triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to put Thousand-Faced Shadow from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it, Arni Metalbrow and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Arni Metalbrow trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Thousand-Faced Shadow trigger, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, it, Arni Metalbrow and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Thousand-Faced Shadow to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Arni Metalbrow trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to put Thousand-Faced Shadow from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

1411-4398.description:
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling the spell and allowing them to cast a copy of each instant and sorcery card exiled by Eye of the Storm without paying its mana cost.
Because Soulless Jailer prevents noncreature spells from being cast from exile, no player may cast spells as permitted by Eye of the Storm.

3089-4050-4075.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least seven.
3089-4050-4075.description:
Cast Master of Waves by paying {3}{U}.
Master of Waves enters the battlefield, creating at least eight 1/0 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing seven Elemental tokens, adding {6}{U}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing an Elemental token, returning Master of Waves from the battlefield to your hand.
Any remaining 1/0 Elemental creature tokens you control die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat.

1309-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1309-1987-3075.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
